scope: Full current relocation quarantine preparation, commit and inventory tests
assessment: Preparation persists verified copy before source removal, preserves partial payload and refuses replaced inode, aliased root, foreign file or changed configuration
Complete payload resumes after injected synchronization interruption without rewriting; directory alias during creation leaves unmanaged target untouched
Commit and restore preserve source inode; stale references and reserved-name collision protect source; restoration does not overwrite foreign bytes
Interrupted commit/restore resume; partial multi-file commit can restore after reference changes and reenable reverse relocation
Inventory verifies private copy bytes, inode and proof; unknown/missing/unreadable roots never become verified zero capacity
Actual CLI and twice restarted HTTP inventory match without mutating observed files

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=tests:plugins/app-store-creative/scripts python3 -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest test_relocation_quarantine_preparation test_relocation_quarantine_commit test_relocation_quarantine_inventory -q

limitations: Injected I/O and permission failures rather than real crash or filesystem access control
Disposable single-filesystem fixtures; actual cross-volume and products separate
